id.description: Stable identifier, matches alignment data and OSM way ID where available

name.description: County road number, street name, or route designation

polyline.description: Centerline vertices in world coordinates [x, z]

width.description: Lane width in meters; default 3.5 for local

intersections.description: IDs of other roads this one meets

canon_ref.description: Path into the canon layer for street-name or route history

confidence.description: 0 = inferred from aerial only, 1 = field-verified alignment
